studies.title: Lop Nur · before 1972
studies.caption: Shallow water and reed beds at Lop Nur before the lake dried up in 1972.
studies.prompt: Historical Lop Nur wetland BEFORE1972 drying, low Tarim basin shore with shallow still water, reed beds and white salt edges against tawny desert horizon. Not a deep mountain lake, no snowy peaks, modern installations or dry concentric satellite-view rings.
